decisive_items: a right breast mass noted for more than 1 year
response.rationale: Long-standing discrete hard breast mass with overlying ulceration and BI-RADS V imaging is most consistent with invasive breast cancer; Paget disease is nipple-centered, inflammatory breast cancer is diffuse/rapid, and triple-negative status cannot be inferred from normal markers.

rejected.why: Normal serum markers do not establish triple-negative subtype; receptor status is not provided.
Paget disease typically involves nipple-areolar skin; the ulceration here overlies a separate 1 o'clock mass.
Too broad because the 'invasive' qualifier is supported by ulceration and imaging.
Inflammatory breast cancer is diffuse and rapidly progressive, whereas this is a long-standing discrete mass.
